app.name: Jaga
app.description: Flood alerts and emergency help for Pattani, Yala, Narathiwat and Songkhla

home.title: Jaga: alert status for your area

notInService.title: Jaga is not in service yet
notInService.body: Jaga starts on 25 October 2026. Nobody is issuing alerts in this app yet. No alert here does not mean there is no risk. Follow official warnings from DDPM and local authorities.

area.label: Your area
area.chooseBody: To see your tambon's alerts and the safe places near you.

area.notCovered: Jaga doesn't cover {province} province yet. In an emergency call 1784 or 1669.
area.outside: This location is outside the area Jaga covers. In an emergency call 1784 or 1669.
area.listFailed: Couldn't load the list of areas. Try again.

home.checklistNote: Ticks are kept on this phone only.

watched.title: Places you watch
watched.addFirst: Add a place you watch, such as Mum's house

summary.normal: Nothing to do now. Know your safe places.
summary.watch: Get ready: pack your go-bag and plan your route.
summary.warning: Flooding is likely here within about 24–48 hours. Move vulnerable people and cars to safe places now.
summary.evacuate: Flooding is imminent or has started. Go to your safe place now. If you are trapped, press SOS.
summary.return: Water has receded in this area. Return carefully.

normal.a: Know the safe places near your home. See the list below.

watch.a: Charge your phones and power banks.
watch.b: Pack important documents and medicine in a go-bag.
watch.c: Plan your route to a safe place.
watch.d: Check on neighbours who are elderly, ill or have small children.

warning.a: Take elderly people, bedridden patients and small children to a safe place now.
warning.b: Move your car to high ground now.
warning.c: Lift valuables and electrical plugs off the floor.
warning.d: Have your go-bag ready to leave the house.

evacuate.a: Go to your safe place now.
evacuate.b: Switch off the main breaker before you leave, if it is safe to do so.
evacuate.c: Don't walk or drive through fast-moving water.
evacuate.d: If you can't leave the house, press SOS.

return.a: Return carefully. Roads and bridges may be damaged.
return.b: Don't switch the power on until you are sure plugs and wires are dry.
return.c: Watch out for snakes and other venomous animals, and for dirty water.
return.d: Photograph the damage before you clean up.

sos.label: SOS

sos.intro: Press the red button to send. Your location goes immediately. No sign-in needed.
sos.phoneHint: Without a number, rescuers can't call you.
sos.phoneBad: That number isn't valid, but your request was still sent.

status.openCaseLink: See the status of your request

sos.soonBody: Asking for help through Jaga opens before the flood season. Right now nobody receives requests from this app. If you need help, call straight away.

setup.title: About you
setup.intro: Only your name is needed to start. Everything else is optional.
setup.nameFirst: A name is needed before that page. Enter it and you will be taken back.

name.label: Display name
name.hint: A nickname is fine. Responders see this name when you ask for help.

phone.label: Phone number (optional)
phone.hint: Without a number, rescuers can't call you. Your number is never public.

home.title: Home location (optional)
